About Nutritics💥
Nutritics is redefining how hospitality and foodservice businesses operate. We give organisations complete clarity and control over their food, menus, supply chains, and environmental impact. Trusted by 500+ customers worldwide, from contract caterers and restaurant groups to healthcare and education providers, we are the platform of choice for businesses that take food data seriously.

Backed by PE investment, we're scaling rapidly across UK&I and entering the US market. Our ambition: to become the world's most trusted food information platform.

We are seeking a commercially minded Account Manager to join our North American commercial team. In this high impact, revenue driving role, you will manage a portfolio of key account relationships across higher education dining, corporate hospitality, grocers, and restaurant groups.
Your primary mission will be to maintain high retention on core back of house operational software accounts (covering daily kitchen tools like production planning, recipe costing, purchasing, and label printing) and lead strategic cross-sell initiatives to expand these clients into Nutritics' platform unlocking advanced sustainability tracking, carbon scoring, and comprehensive allergen management.

Main Responsibilities💻
You will:
  • Own the renewals process for an assigned book of business, ensuring a high retention rate and maximising expansion opportunities.
  • Negotiate contract renewals directly with customers, handling pricing discussions, upsell offers, and any necessary escalations.
  • Leverage pricing discretion to apply price increases where possible and drive additional revenue growth.
  • Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities, working closely with Customer Success and Sales teams.
  • Forecast and track renewal performance, ensuring transparency in renewal revenue, churn risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Optimise the renewals playbook, refining outreach strategies, negotiation tactics, and pricing models.
  • Work closely with the finance function to understand current processes and drive the business forward by updating and optimising those processes in collaboration with the finance and commercial teams.

Career Progression and Development🚀
At Nutritics, growth is built into how we operate and we believe that the best way for our business to grow is for our people to grow. As we scale internationally with the backing of private equity investment, we create real opportunities for people to stretch their skills, take on new challenges, and shape the future of our platform and our industry.
You can expect:
  • Impact and Recognition: Join a team delivering significant global growth where you can feel and see the direct impact of your individual contributions.
  • Expert Collaboration:Learn from working alongside an experienced management team and market leading clients around the world.
  • Structured Growth:Benefit from bi-annual performance reviews and a personalised career development plan tailored to your ambitions.
  • Mentorship and Coaching: Access ongoing support and opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the business scales.
  • Global Pathways:Take advantage of clear progression routes into senior leadership and specialist roles as we continue our international expansion.

The Ideal candidate will have🙌
  • To be passionate about Nutritics and bring that enthusiasm to work daily. We want you to be focused on quality delivery and doing an excellent job that you can take pride in.
  • Strong negotiation & communication skills and experience handling commercial discussions directly with customers.
  • Ability to identify and close upsell/cross-sell opportunities within an existing customer base.
  • Analytical mindset with experience tracking revenue performance and customer retention metrics.
  • Self-starter mentality with a passion for hitting and exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience with CRM and Q2C (Quote-to-Cash) tools is a plus but not required.
  • Previous experience in Foodservice and/or nutrition is an advantage but not essential.

Most Importantly👍
Nutritics is a people first business scaling at a world class pace, and we are looking for individuals who align with our five core values: Team First, Open Communication, No Ego, Integrity, and The Rocket🚀. We take our mission seriously but don’t take ourselves too seriously, fostering a collaborative spirit where transparency, openness and results are valued over hierarchy. By joining us, you become part of an award winning culture that balances high speed international growth with a genuine commitment to the wellbeing and development of every team member.

Compensation Range 💰
Nutritics provides a range for base pay. Where you sit within it depends on factors including your job-related knowledge, skills, experience, education and training, location, and the scope of the role.

Base salary: $85,000 – $115,000 per year
OTE: $132,800 – $179,000 per year (base + commission)

  • Competitive Paid Time Off (PTO) policy.
  • Training & Development Programmes.
  • Excellent work life balance policies - Summer hours, Enhanced parenting leave options etc.
  • Generous personal Health & Wellbeing budget.
  • Competitive base salary, attractive commission structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
    • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision insurance plans
    • Sales Incentive
    • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
    • Life and Disability insurance.
  • Unparalleled opportunities to a rewarding & diverse career path - progression opportunities into the Sales team.

Location and Hours of Work🌍
Our weekly hours of work are 40 covering Monday to Friday. Remote (US based, with a strong preference for candidates based in or near Boston, MA).

Travel: a small amount of travel will be required to meet customers in person, as well as to attend conferences and industry events.

Interested to join our all-star team? Submit your application to us now! Tell us why you want to work with us and why you think you’d be a good candidate. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

The ideal candidate is a "Hands-on Leader" who possesses a deep technical foundation across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and excels in strategic Presales. You will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence, managing cross-border teams, and acting as the bridge between business requirements and successful technical execution.

  • Solutioning & Estimation: Develop detailed Fixed-Price Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and high-level project roadmaps.
  • Resource Planning: Build comprehensive Staffing Plans, identifying key roles and optimizing resource allocation for bid competitiveness.
  • Financial Strategy: Collaborate with stakeholders to define solution costing, pricing strategies, and "Win-Themes" for high-value tenders.

B. Technical Governance & Architectural Oversight

  • Architectural Reviewer & Governor: Serve as the final technical authority to review and validate system designs and architectures, ensuring alignment with C4 Model (Context, Container, Component, Code) standards.
  • Infrastructure Oversight: Provide strategic guidance and technical validation for complex infrastructure designs, such as active-active hot-standby topologies and multi-country API gateways.

  • DevSecOps: Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines (SHIP-HATS, Jenkins) and security tools (SonarQube, Fortify, NexusIQ, VAPT).

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience: Minimum 7 years in the IT industry, with at least 5 years in leadership roles (Delivery Manager, Solution Architect, or Senior TPM).
  • Track Record: Proven experience managing projects with a Total Contract Value (TCV) of $1M - $5M+.
  • Standards: Familiarity with regulated environment standards such as Singapore Government and IM8 is highly preferred.
  • Skills: Exceptional analytical skills for WBS creation, strong proficiency in English for international client engagement and proposal writing.

WHY'S US

  • Opportunity to contribute to a large-scale Singapore education modernization initiative
  • High-ownership architecture role with meaningful technical impact
  • Exposure to enterprise cloud modernization and government-grade architecture standards
  • Collaborative and fast-moving engineering culture
  • Work alongside senior technical leaders across Singapore and Vietnam

raw.excerpt: THE ROLE 📝We’re looking for a Business Analyst with strong payments experience to join Form3’s Product team and play an important role in building out our new Canadian Real-Time Rail (RTR) payment gateway.
raw.description:
THE ROLE 📝

We’re looking for a Business Analyst with strong payments experience to join Form3’s Product team and play an important role in building out our new Canadian Real-Time Rail (RTR) payment gateway.

Working closely with the Product Manager, you’ll be involved from an early stage in the build, helping to understand payment scheme and business requirements and turn them into clear, actionable requirements that support the development and delivery of the product.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Work closely with the Product Manager to support the end-to-end build and delivery of Form3’s Canadian RTR payment gateway.
  • Understand and analyse payment scheme, product and business requirements, translating these into clear and actionable requirements.
  • Create high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria and functional and non-functional specifications.
  • Analyse the impact of product changes and enhancements and clearly document requirements to support delivery.
  • Use data and analysis to provide insights and support informed product decisions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Engineering and the wider business throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Build deep knowledge of the Canadian payments ecosystem, becoming a trusted source of payments expertise for colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of key Business Analyst activities and deliverables, helping the team move from requirements through to successful product delivery.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍

As RTR is a new payment scheme, we don’t expect you to have previous RTR experience. What’s much more important is a strong understanding of the Canadian payments landscape and infrastructure, with experience of payment rails such as Interac e-Transfer.

Knowledge of the wider North American payments landscape, including US schemes such as FedNow or RTP, would also be valuable.

Essential

  • Experience working as a Business Analyst within payments, banking or FinTech.
  • Strong knowledge of the Canadian payments ecosystem and infrastructure, ideally including experience with Interac e-Transfer or other Canadian payment rails.
  • Experience translating complex business, product or payment scheme requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, cloud technologies and modern system architectures, with the ability to translate business requirements into clear technical requirements and collaborate effectively with Engineering teams.
  • A good understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience supporting products from requirements through to delivery.
  • Strong analytical skills, including experience using data to support decision-making.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to make complex payment concepts clear and actionable.
  • The ability to work autonomously, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable

  • Knowledge or experience of the US payments landscape, particularly real-time payment schemes such as FedNow and RTP.
  • Experience working with real-time or instant payments.
  • Broader knowledge of payment schemes, payment infrastructure and how financial institutions move money.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️

Stage One: Screening Call with the Talent Team
Stage Two: Team Interview with a Senior Business Analyst and Senior Product Manager
Stage Three: Zoom Interview with two Heads of Product
Stage Four: Executive Review with the Chief Product Officer

We always aim to stick to the above process; however, there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is required for us to be sure we are hiring the right person!

HIRING LOCATION 📍

We are hiring remotely within the Canada in the following provinces:

  • Ontario

All new joiners start their first day in one of our offices to collect the equipment needed to work remotely.

BENEFITS 🏝️

Form3 is a 100% remote, flexible business and can offer part-time working arrangements. We believe this enables our people to achieve amazing things while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

For further information on what it’s like to work here and our full benefits package, visit our careers page. If you have any other questions, we’d be happy to discuss these during the interview process.

ABOUT FORM3 💭

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages:

What we do | Life at Form3 | Benefits | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast

OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT

We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences.

Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be.

As an inclusive employer, we guarantee to interview all neurodiverse and physically disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. We also encourage candidates to notify us of any reasonable adjustments that may be required during the recruitment process. This includes providing job adverts in alternative, accessible formats or adjustments required at interview stage.

If you consider yourself to be neurodiverse or physically disabled under the UN definition of disability and would like to be considered under this scheme and/or require any reasonable adjustments please let us know by sending an email to clearly stating your consent for us to process this data.

For more information please refer to our Recruitment Data Policy.

raw.title: ZetSol Energy - Director of Sales
raw.excerpt: ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing.
raw.description:
ZetSol Energy is the solar manufacturing and supply chain platform built to give North American solar developers, EPCs, utilities, and independent power producers a reliable, tariff-compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing. The company is establishing a vertically integrated greenfield facility in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, producing silicon ingots, monocrystalline wafers, cells, and modules, including high-efficiency TOPCon and HJT technology, and pairs that manufacturing base with a full strategic sourcing, bill-of-materials management, quality audit, compliance, and logistics practice purpose-built for the US market.

ZetSol Energy is backed by Zetwerk, a global manufacturing platform valued at over $2.7 billion that already supplies solar piles, mechanical and structural components, and modules to leading US EPCs and asset owners, and whose 2022 acquisition of Unimacts strengthened its US industrial and solar manufacturing footprint. ZetSol Energy is the next chapter of that build-out: a dedicated US-facing commercial platform launching at a moment when American solar developers are actively searching for supply chain partners who can deliver both scale and certainty.

The Opportunity

Become one of ZetSol Energy's first three Regional Sales Heads in the United States, each owning a zone / territory (East Coast, Central, or West Coast) and building it from the ground up. This is a founding commercial role: you will be establishing ZetSol's presence with VP-level sourcing, procurement, and supply chain executives across the solar industry, opening doors where none currently exist, and translating a genuinely differentiated manufacturing and supply chain story into signed volume. Your hunter instinct, your comfort building a territory without an existing playbook, and your appreciation for the technical substance behind the pitch will set the pace for ZetSol's growth in North America.

Each Regional Sales Head starts as an individual contributor carrying full ownership of their territory's pipeline. As the US business scales, each will grow into a player-coach role, taking on a Junior Sales Executive to mentor and develop, a natural next step for someone who wants to build not just a book of business but a team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales lifecycle within your territory, from initial outreach and technical qualification through contract negotiation, closing, and account growth.
  • Drive utility-scale module and supply chain sales by pitching ZetSol's integrated manufacturing capabilities and customized, tariff-compliant sourcing solutions to US solar developers, EPCs, and asset owners.
  • Build and maintain a high-value pipeline of solar EPCs, developers, and IPPs seeking a reliable, compliant alternative to fragmented overseas sourcing.
  • Consult on volume procurement, structure and negotiate supply agreements, deliver custom bill-of-materials sourcing solutions, and navigate international supply compliance and US import regulations.
  • Track industry movement within your territory, identifying new markets, greenfield accounts, and new-logo opportunities to expand ZetSol's US footprint.
  • Partner with manufacturing, engineering, and marketing teams to shape ZetSol's US product and service offering based on what you are hearing in the field.
  • Represent ZetSol Energy at industry trade shows and conferences, and participate actively in regular team and leadership meetings.
  • Provide accurate, regular pipeline and demand forecasts to support production planning and a frictionless supply chain.
  • As your territory matures, mentor and manage a Junior Sales Executive, extending your reach and developing the next generation of ZetSol talent.

Requirements

  • 10 - 20 years in B2B renewable energy sales, solar hardware procurement, or solar supply chain management, targeting the US market.
  • Strong command of solar components, including N-type cells, TOPCon and HJT modules, and ingot and wafer supply chains, along with US import regulations, tariffs, and compliance requirements.
  • Comfort delivering a C-suite narrative to CTOs, procurement heads, and project directors across the renewables sector.
  • Established understanding of the solar developer, EPC, utility, and IPP landscape within your assigned territory (East Coast, Central, or West Coast) and its key players.
  • Strong customer orientation paired with fluency in CRM systems and standard Microsoft tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams).

Desired Qualifications

  • A substantial network of senior management or VP-level supply chain and procurement executives you can bring to bear in growing ZetSol's footprint.
  • A track record of proven business and sales acumen navigating complex, multi-stakeholder account cycles.
  • A technical grounding in solar manufacturing or components, paired with intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to integrity.

Why ZetSol Energy

  • You are one of the first three commercial hires shaping how ZetSol Energy goes to market in the United States, not inheriting a territory, building one.
  • A defined path from individual contributor to player-coach, with the opportunity to hire and develop a Junior Sales Executive as your territory grows.
  • Backed by Zetwerk's global manufacturing scale and an established US solar track record, giving you a credible, differentiated story to bring to every conversation.
  • Full ownership of your territory's strategy and pipeline, with direct visibility into how your results shape the broader US build-out.

raw.description:
About Omniful:

Omniful gives businesses one place to run everything operations and supply chain. It brings together all of the operating systems that are normally scattered across a company, like Order Management, Shipping Gateway, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Supply Chain, Point of Sale and more. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the operations lifecycle in a single system.

Omniful enables retail, logistics, D2C brands, and e-commerce businesses to scale efficiently and enhance customer satisfaction through a unified, vertically integrated solution.

Based in Riyadh, KSA, Omniful has raised $10+M from the region’s top investors RAED Ventures, VentureSouq, SEEDRA Ventures, Jahez Group, DASH Ventures, Bunat Ventures, Sanabil 500,and is considered one of the fastest-growing SaaS startups that came out of the MENA region.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @omniful.com or @omniful.ai addresses.

Role Overview:

As an Account Manager at Omniful, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing the commercial relationships with our existing clients. Your primary focus will be on driving revenue growth through collections, upselling, and cross-selling Omniful’s solutions. This role is vital to ensuring client satisfaction, optimizing value realization, and maximizing expansion opportunities within the customer base. Working closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams, you will ensure clients continue to see the value in Omniful’s offerings and choose to grow their partnership with us.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Commercial Relationship Management:

    • Manage the commercial relationship with assigned clients, serving as their primary point of contact for all commercial matters, including billing, renewals, and contract negotiations.

    • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and influencers within client organizations to drive revenue growth and ensure client satisfaction.

  • Revenue Expansion:

    • Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities by understanding client needs and aligning additional Omniful products and solutions to their business goals.

    • Collaborate with the Sales and Product teams to create tailored offerings and proposals that maximize value for the client and drive expansion revenue.

    • Proactively engage clients to assess their satisfaction and potential needs, presenting relevant upgrades and enhancements that support their growth and operational efficiency.

  • Collections and Contract Management:

    • Manage and oversee collections for assigned clients, ensuring timely payment of invoices and addressing any billing issues or disputes in a professional and efficient manner.

    • Negotiate contract renewals and terms, working closely with the Legal and Finance teams to ensure compliance with company policies and client agreements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Work with the Customer Success team to gain insights into client usage and adoption, using this data to inform commercial strategies and identify additional revenue opportunities.

    • Coordinate with Marketing and Product teams to stay informed about product updates, new features, and industry trends, leveraging this knowledge to engage clients and showcase Omniful’s ongoing value.

    • Provide feedback to Product and Sales teams regarding client needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics to enhance Omniful’s offerings and go-to-market strategies.

  • Data Analysis and Reporting:

    • Track and analyze client performance metrics, including revenue growth, churn risk, and product usage, to identify areas for improvement and inform engagement strategies.

    • Prepare regular reports on client revenue, collections status, upselling/cross-selling performance, and other key metrics for internal stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 3-5+ years in account management, sales, or a related role with a strong emphasis on managing commercial relationships and driving revenue growth.

  • Sales and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record of successfully upselling and cross-selling products/services and managing contract negotiations.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build trust-based relationships.

  • Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of collections processes, revenue forecasting, and managing financial aspects of client relationships.

  • Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Customer Success, and Product, to ensure cohesive client engagement.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Deep commitment to understanding and delivering on client needs and business goals.

  • Results-Driven: Focus on achieving measurable outcomes, with a proven ability to drive revenue growth and expansion within existing accounts.

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to identify challenges and develop creative, client-focused solutions.

  • High Ownership: Proactive, accountable, and driven to exceed client expectations and internal targets.

Why Join Omniful?

  • Impactful Work: Directly influence the growth of a fast-scaling company at the forefront of operations and supply chain management.

  • Innovative Culture: Join a team committed to continuous improvement, creativity, and excellence.

  • Growth Opportunity: Shape Omniful’s growth trajectory with significant influence over strategic revenue initiatives. How many companies in the market can you say has a global potential to reach hundreds of millions of dollars in annual revenue, from the region?

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and equity options.

At Omniful, we’re building a culture that attracts and empowers the top 0.1% of smart relentless talent individuals who think and act with the ingenuity of hackers and the boldness of pirates. Here, high ownership, deep accountability, and a ‘whatever it takes’ mentality aren’t just encouragedthey’re required! We cut through politics and bureaucracy to focus on what truly matters: solving complex challenges, driving meaningful impact, and creating the future of operations and supply chain management. If you’re ready to break boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make a lasting legacy for decades to come, Omniful is where you belong.

If you’re a driven account manager passionate about building and optimizing commercial relationships, we’d love to meet you!

raw.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is hiring exceptional candidates with a Masters degree in mental health and previous work experience facilitating groups to provide remote, telehealth services to our adolescent and young adult clients. We’re eager to work with forward-thinking mental health professionals to enhance our programming and provide the best possible care to our clients.

People know Charlie Health for our warm and empathetic clinical team. While each individual clinician has their own interests, expertise, and style, we require all team members to be well versed in a variety of modalities. Our clients are struggling to cope with underlying mental health issues and benefit from therapists that are sophisticated and relational. Successful candidates are committed to bettering the mental health of their clients, along with being adept at self-care, ensuring they are prepared to give their best every day to address the youth mental health crisis.

Responsibilities

  • Complete all Onboarding requirements within 2 weeks of start date
  • Meet with your assigned Charlie Health Group Quality Supervisor or Group Quality Director at a minimum of 1x/month for required check-in
  • Respond to all email and Slack communication promptly (within 48 hours of receiving a communication)
  • Review the curriculum aligned to group assignment prior to group start time
  • Arrive ~10 minutes early to scheduled group time and facilitate all groups for the entirety of the hour
  • Facilitate groups following Charlie Health best practices and using assigned and most up to date Charlie Health curriculum
  • Facilitate groups across age groups and cohorts, including Integrative curriculum, Support Staffing and Wellness Hour as needed
  • Foster client engagement and group cohesion throughout the session, encouraging client participation and fostering camera-on culture
  • Following all operational policies and procedures as indicated by Charlie Health best practices
  • Participate in collaborative Treatment Team (Tuesdays) and Group Supervision (every other Friday) with your assigned Charlie Health Group Quality Supervisor or Group Quality Director, peers and other Clinical Leadership team members
  • Work collaboratively and respectfully across the care team including with Primary Therapists, Care Experience Specialists and Care Coaches
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and promptly with all clients, staff, families, agencies, and referents
  • Monitor your treatment documentation to ensure all of your notes are completed within required 24 hour timeframe and meet agency and professional standards per DHCS and The Joint Commission standards
  • Maintain and model professional ethics, including appropriate boundaries and confidentiality
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Must be available during late afternoons and evenings on weekdays (3-8pm MT on Monday to Thursday) and on Saturdays to meet the schedules of our adolescent and young adult clients
  • Master’s degree in mental health or related field required (see below for full list)
  • Experience working with youth and young adults
  • Well versed in a variety of modalities and feel confident integrating them into your treatment approach (DBT, CBT, EMDR, MI certification is a plus)
  • Passionate about the benefits of group treatment and skilled in conducting group treatment
  • Ability to work effectively in a team
  • Creative and engaging, especially over video!
  • The technical ability to run effective telehealth sessions
  • Reliable WIFI connection when meeting with clients
  • Familiarity with and willingness to use cloud-based communication software—Gmail, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox–in addition to EMR and outcomes survey software on a daily basis
  • Part time 1099 role

Benefits

  • Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Eligible Master's Degrees:

  • Master of Science (M.S.) in Mental Health Counseling
  • Master of Arts (M.A.) in Counseling Psychology
  • Master of Social Work (M.S.W.) with a concentration in Mental Health
  • Master of Science (M.S.) in Clinical Mental Health Counseling
  • Master of Arts (M.A.) in Marriage and Family Therapy
  • Master of Arts (M.A.) in Clinical Psychology
  • Master of Science (M.S.) in School Counseling
  • Master of Science (M.S.) in Rehabilitation Counseling
  • Master of Science (M.S.) in Applied Developmental Psychology
  • Master of Arts (M.A) in Education (with experience in behavioral health)

Florida requires a fingerprint based background check, with more information found here. Please note that the cost for this background check will be paid for in full by Charlie Health.

Job Title: Director - Computer Systems Validation

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Director of Computer Systems Validation Program provides support to the Quality, Regulatory and Compliance function in support of qualification of Veeva Vault technology.
Primarily responsible for oversight of the assigned Validation teams to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery of computer system validation activities supporting general releases and patches/hot fixes. Plan and drive complex validation tasks (periodic review, new product introduction) across the Validation teams while advancing modern validation practices, including test automation strategies and the governance and validation of AI-driven capabilities. Mentor and develop leaders of the assigned Validation teams providing technical validation expertise, interpretation, and direction to assure compliance with GxP (GMP, GCP, Device) regulatory requirements, company policies and standards regarding validation, document control and change management.
Additional responsibility is to support the audit management function by presenting CSV operations during customer audits.

What You'll Do

We are looking for experienced English-Spanish interpreters based in Latin America to join our remote team in a blended Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) role starting in October 2026.

As an interpreter, you will facilitate clear and accurate communication between English- and Spanish-speaking individuals across medical, social service, customer care, and financial settings. You will use consecutive interpretation techniques to ensure that all parties understand one another while maintaining professionalism, impartiality, confidentiality, and accuracy.

Important: A minimum of six months of verifiable professional experience in remote OPI and/or VRI interpretation is mandatory. Candidates without the required experience will not be considered.

Bonus amounts, eligibility criteria, and applicable program terms will be communicated during the recruitment process.

  • Spanish Proficiency: Native or native-level Spanish fluency, with excellent comprehension and active listening skills.

Internet Connection

Approved models include:

  • Microsoft LifeChat LX-6000

  • Plantronics Blackwire C3220

The exact headset model must meet the client's technical specifications and approval requirements.

Computer and Video

  • Processor: Intel Core i5, 6th generation or newer.

  • Webcam: 720p or 1080p resolution.

  • Browser: An updated version of Chrome, Safari, Microsoft Edge, or Firefox.

  • Work Environment: A quiet, distraction-free space suitable for confidential interpretation sessions.

Start Date

October 2026

Selected candidates must be available to complete the recruitment, technical verification, and client onboarding requirements before their assigned start date.

Ready to Apply?

If you have at least six months of remote OPI/VRI interpretation experience, meet the English and Spanish proficiency requirements, and have the required technical equipment, we encourage you to apply.

Join Kreato Global and help bridge language barriers through meaningful, high-quality communication.

Apply today to be considered for our October 2026 intake!

We are looking for a Coach in Trading

Job Title: Trader Coach
﻿Set up: WFH
﻿﻿Monthly Salary: PHP40,000 per month with commission
﻿Workday: Monday to Friday, Shifting schedule

Job Description:

Position Overview:

A Trader Coach is responsible for providing guidance, support, and mentorship to individuals or teams of traders to enhance their trading skills, develop effective strategies, and manage risk in financial markets. Trader Coaches help traders improve their decision-making abilities, emotional resilience, and overall performance in various trading environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Mentorship and Training: Provide one-on-one or group coaching sessions to traders, helping them understand trading principles, technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and trading psychology. Assist in the development of personalized trading plans.
  • Performance Analysis: Evaluate traders' performance by analyzing their trading history, risk management practices, and overall strategies. Identify areas for improvement and develop action plans to address weaknesses.
  • Risk Management: Educate traders on effective risk management techniques, including position sizing, stop-loss orders, and portfolio diversification, to minimize losses and protect capital.
  • Trading Psychology: Address traders' emotional challenges such as fear, greed, and overtrading. Teach strategies to maintain discipline and emotional stability during market fluctuations.
  • Market Research: Stay up to date with market developments, news, and trends to provide traders with relevant information and insights. Share market analysis and potential trading opportunities.
  • Strategy Development: Collaborate with traders to design and refine trading strategies tailored to their risk tolerance, goals, and preferred asset classes (e.g., stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, commodities).
  • Technical Analysis: Teach traders how to use technical indicators, charts, and patterns to make informed trading decisions. Help traders spot potential entry and exit points.
  • Record Keeping: Encourage traders to maintain meticulous records of their trades, including entry and exit points, profit and loss figures, and trade commentary. Analyze these records for continuous improvement.
  • Compliance and Regulation: Ensure that traders are aware of and comply with relevant financial regulations and exchange rules to maintain ethical and legal trading practices.
  • Feedback and Support: Provide constructive feedback and support to traders on an ongoing basis. Encourage open communication and a growth-oriented mindset.
  • Goal Setting: Assist traders in setting realistic and achievable trading goals. Monitor progress toward these goals and adjust strategies as needed.
  • Education and Skill Development: Stay updated with industry best practices, trading technologies, and educational resources. Share knowledge with traders to enhance their skills.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a successful trader, preferably in various financial markets.
  • Strong knowledge of technical and fundamental analysis.
  • Excellent understanding of risk management principles.
  • Proficiency in trading platforms and software.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Patience, empathy, and the ability to motivate and inspire traders.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with trading regulations and compliance.
  • Continuous learning mindset to keep up with evolving market trends.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Chartered Market Technician, Certified Financial Technician) may be advantageous.
  • A Trader Coach plays a crucial role in helping traders achieve their financial goals while minimizing risks. This position requires a deep understanding of trading principles, psychological factors, and market dynamics to guide traders toward success

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

The Digital Data Networks (DDN) Business Unit is seeking a highly skilled and driven PRINCIPAL R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEER within the Advanced Development (AD) team. In this key technical role, you will be responsible for spearheading structural mechanics, thermal-mechanical coupling, and multi-physics modeling to rapidly screen, evaluate, and down-select next-generation high-speed interconnect technology concepts. You will tackle critical engineering challenges across switches, servers, data storage systems, and AI hardware platforms—pushing the boundaries of density, signal integrity, and mechanical reliability.

As a senior technical contributor in the DDN Advanced Development team, you will establish first-principles analytical models and high-fidelity simulations to generate decision-quality performance predictions. You will lead simulation-driven design trade-offs, drive model-to-test correlation, and partner closely with cross-functional teams including Signal Integrity, Mechanical Design, Product Management, and Front-Line Product Engineering (PDE/NPI). Additionally, you will play an instrumental role in shaping the team’s Advanced Simulation roadmap and maturing virtual prototyping methodologies.

Key qualifications include a proven track record of superior technical expertise in finite element analysis (FEA), advanced mechanical and thermal-mechanical modeling, and a passion for engineering innovation. You are expected to drive prediction-driven decision-making through rigorous model verification and validation (V&V), clearly communicate engineering trade-offs, and mentor engineering peers in best simulation practices.

Job Requirements

  • Lead the development, application, and continuous improvement of first-principles engineering analysis, FEA modeling, and multi-physics simulation to down-select solution concepts.
  • Build first principles and reduced-order mechanical/thermal models to quickly screen early architectures and identify scaling limits.
  • Execute advanced high-fidelity non-linear structural and thermal-mechanical simulations (e.g., elastoplastic deformation, creep, stress relaxation, thermal expansion/CTE mismatch, contact mechanics, and insertion/retention force).
  • Perform sensitivity studies, tolerance stack-ups, and statistical variation analyses to understand assembly robustness, coplanarity, and risk early in the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with design engineers to define simulation-ready geometry, boundary conditions, and loading scenarios supported by GD&T interpretation.
  • Handle complex FEA models involving hundreds of components in high-speed interconnect systems to build high-fidelity simulation models. Simplify models as appropriate to balance simulation accuracy, computational efficiency, and delivery timelines.
  • Deliver comprehensive simulation reports, actionable design recommendations, and technical presentations to drive executive and architectural down-selection.
  • Define and lead physical prototype test plans; actively partner with test labs to execute model verification and validation (V&V), correlate experimental data with simulation results, and calibrate constitutive material models.
  • Collaborate with PDE/NPI teams to ensure smooth handoff of validated simulation models, design guidelines, and predictive methodologies for commercialization.
  • Champion simulation process automation, script development, and methodology standardization across the engineering group.
  • Maintain deep awareness of cutting-edge simulation tools, high-performance computing (HPC/Cloud), advanced material systems, and emerging packaging/interconnect technologies.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or related field; Master’s Degree or Ph.D. strongly preferred.
  • Generally requires 8–10+ years of progressive engineering experience in high-fidelity FEA and structural/thermal-mechanical analysis in high-tech electromechanical products, connectors, high-speed interconnects, or electronic packaging.
  • Recognized technical expert in commercial FEA platforms (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, preferred) with demonstrated mastery in non-linear materials, complex contact interfaces, dynamic response, and thermal-stress coupling.
  • Strong practical experience in test correlation and model calibration (e.g., strain gauge testing, displacement/force measurement, thermal warpage profiling).
  • Deep understanding of high-speed interconnect architecture, micro-contact physics, spring pin design, socket/cable assemblies, and CTE management in AI/compute hardware environments.
  • Working knowledge of 3D CAD platforms (Creo and SpaceClaim preferred) for geometric defeaturing, parameterization, and simulation prep.
  • Experience with cloud/HPC simulation environments (e.g., Rescale) and automation scripting (Python, MATLAB) is a plus.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, global R&D environment, translating complex technical findings into actionable engineering guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Competencies

  • Values: Integrity, Accountability, Teamwork, Innovation
  • Technical Leadership & Influence (Individual Contributor track)
  • Problem Solving & Analytical Rigor

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

raw.description:
Stacklok is led by CEO Craig McLuckie and CTO Joe Beda, two of the creators of Kubernetes. As AI reshapes how software is built and used, we're building the foundation enterprises need to adopt it with confidence.

We're building the control plane for enterprise AI agents, enabling organizations to run, govern, and secure them on the infrastructure they already trust. Through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers running across Kubernetes and private cloud environments, AI agents can securely connect to internal data and systems while meeting the security, compliance, and operational requirements of highly regulated and security-conscious organizations. We've also extended this foundation to the model layer with an enterprise AI gateway.

The Stacklok Enterprise Platform is built on ToolHive, our open source MCP platform, and is already being adopted by leading technology companies and organizations in regulated industries. We also help maintain the official MCP registry and contribute openly to the community shaping the future of enterprise AI.

Location

This is a remote role based in North America, with a strong preference for candidates located in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone.

The Opportunity

Enterprises are moving AI agents from experimentation into production, and they need infrastructure that is secure, auditable, and runs behind their own firewall. As a Senior Engineer on Stacklok's core platform team, you will own subsystems within Stacklok Enterprise, the production distribution of ToolHive, the open source platform for running and governing MCP servers.

This is a role with real ownership. You will design and deliver whole subsystems end to end, anchor meaningful projects, and lead them from design through implementation and into production. These are the systems that let Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies run AI agents securely at scale. You will make the design tradeoffs that determine how your subsystems evolve, and mentor the engineers building alongside you.

The timing is what makes it compelling. Customers are signing on now, the platform is being hardened for their production environments, and you will solve hard infrastructure problems in an emerging category alongside a team whose founders co-created Kubernetes.

What Success Looks Like: First 6-12 Months

  • Designed and shipped a complete subsystem end to end that is now running in production for enterprise customers.
  • Became the trusted owner and go-to decision maker for one or more platform areas, with the team routing design questions your way.
  • Took a rough or partial subsystem to production-hardened, measurably improving its reliability or scalability for customer deployments.
  • Raised the team's bar by mentoring SWE and SWE II engineers and strengthening the code review culture.
  • Improved how the team ships by tightening development velocity, including where AI-assisted workflows helped and where they created rework.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the design and implementation of platform subsystems end to end, from technical design through production and ongoing improvement.
  • Anchor meaningful projects, making the design tradeoffs that balance reliability, scalability, and time to market.
  • Write production-ready code aligned with the overall system architecture, with observability, testing, and error handling built in.
  • Produce clear design docs and work breakdowns that the team can plan and build against.
  • Mentor SWE and SWE II engineers and contribute to a strong code review culture across the team.
  • Contribute to technical decisions alongside technical leads, product, and engineering leadership on behalf of the team.
  • Contribute to the open source ToolHive codebase and collaborate with community contributors on shared work.

Desired Skill & Experience

We do not expect every candidate to meet every point below. If this role excites you and you bring most of it, we encourage you to apply.

  • Deep proficiency in Go, with a proven track record building production-grade backend or platform systems.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container technologies, including operators, isolation, and networking in production environments.
  • Proven track record designing and shipping complete systems end to end, from architecture through production and iteration.
  • Demonstrated experience as a tech lead: mentoring engineers, driving code review, and raising the quality of a team's work.
  • Experience designing for reliability and observability, building systems with monitoring, testing, and evaluation in mind.
  • Proven track record building or operating platform services such as gateways, registries, runtimes, or deployment tooling. Familiarity with MCP is a plus.
  • AI-first mindset: integrates AI tools into development and helps improve how the team ships, turning AI-assisted workflows into repeatable velocity gains.
  • Communication: excellent written and verbal communication, able to explain complex technical ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Startup mentality and intrinsic motivation: self-directed and hands-on, thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and drives clarity through action.

Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $189,000 - $231,000. In addition to base salary, this role offers equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Why Join Us?

At Stacklok, we believe great technology is built by teams that support, challenge, and inspire one another. We are AI maximalists, confident in its potential and committed to ensuring it is used in ways that are safe and sustainable.

You will join a highly motivated, collaborative team with deep experience building some of the world's most impactful technologies, with strong roots in open source, cloud-native technologies, security, and developer tools.

We offer competitive compensation and equity, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO and paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a flexible, hybrid-or-remote work environment, plus team offsites in unique destinations to collaborate and connect in person.

If you're excited about the future of AI and want to build alongside people who care deeply about their craft, their community, and each other, we would love to hear from you.

Stacklok Inc, is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law.

Job Title: NOC Engineer

About the Client: ﻿Our client is a managed service provider (MSP) that delivers IT infrastructure management, network monitoring, and technical support to multiple business clients. They help maintain network and server performance, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure reliable IT operations across client environments.

Overview:

The NOC Engineer is the first line of response for the alerts that keep client environments healthy and secure. This role responds to and triages backup alerts, security alerts, and monitoring alerts, including devices and services that go offline, and drives each one to resolution or a clean, well-documented escalation, especially in the case of ISP outages and working with 3rd party ISP vendors.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with strong critical thinking, disciplined time management, and excellent communication skills. They know when to act, when to escalate, and how to keep clients and teammates informed.

Responsibilities:

Alert Response and Triage

  • Backup alerts. Monitor, respond to, and triage backup alerts, including failed, missed, and warning backup jobs.
  • Monitoring alerts. Respond to monitoring alerts such as offline servers, workstations, and services. Verify scope and impact, perform initial troubleshooting, and restore service or escalate.
  • Security alerts. Monitor and triage security alerts from endpoint and managed detection and response tools and determine whether an alert is a false positive or requires remediation.

Incident Handling

  • Follow documented SOPs for alert triage, documenting steps taken, and escalating as needed.
  • Perform basic data and system restores in accordance with documented procedures and client requirements.
  • Contact clients, ISPs, vendors, and internal resources as needed to understand scope and impact.
  • Escalate issues to the appropriate team member with clear context, evidence, and steps already taken.

Ticketing, Documentation, and Communication

  • Create, manage, and update tickets generated from alerts or assigned tasks, keeping notes clear, complete, and timely.
  • Keep clients and teammates informed with concise, professional status updates, including impact, actions underway, and next steps.
  • Use and update IT Glue documentation, and flag missing or outdated SOPs and runbooks.

Systems and Tools

The NOC Engineer should be familiar with, or able to quickly become proficient in, the following:

  • Microsoft Windows: Full familiarity with Windows Operating Systems and technologies.
  • Microsoft 365: Familiar with Entra AD, Office 365, Email and Exchange Online.
  • NinjaOne RMM: Device monitoring, offline-device alerts, remote access and remediation, backup/monitoring alert triage.
  • ConnectWise Manage: Ticket creation, management, updates, escalation, and time entry.
  • IT Glue: Client documentation, SOPs, runbooks, credentials and configuration references.
  • CrowdStrike: Endpoint detection and response alert review, triage, and containment actions per SOP.
  • PRTG Network Monitoring Software: Network monitoring, ISP outage remediation.
  • Datto BCDR: Backup viability and test restores.

Qualifications:

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and desktop operating systems, Microsoft 365, and basic networking concepts.

raw.title: Director of HR
raw.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
raw.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours.

You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes.

We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it.

If you want to own a function, make it extraordinary, and be judged on whether it actually got better, keep reading.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership, immediately. Performance, total rewards, and compliance are yours to own rather than support. You'll defend a compensation number in front of a CFO who checks it.
  • An SVP who wants to hand this over. Not one who says that and then rewrites your deck. The explicit goal is that the HR function runs without him.
  • Executive reach by default. Calibration and leveling decisions live with the C-suite, and you present your own work. You won't spend year one convincing anyone that performance management matters.
  • Leverage is part of the mandate, not a side project. We are tech-first and AI-forward, which means we can run lean teams and do more with less. You'll push that further, build the tooling managers actually open, and make everything easier without taking substance out of it. Nobody will ask you to do it the slow way.

How This Team Is Led

From Kris Osborne, SVP of Talent.

I'll tell you what I want and what the constraints are and then get out of the way. I don't rewrite people's work. If I disagree with where you landed you'll hear it from me early, and if you still think you're right then push back, because I'd rather change my mind than have you go quiet and build something you don't believe in.

I ask before I decide. When something changes the shape of this team the people on it hear it from me first and they get a real say in it, not a heads up after it's done.

I care about the outcome and I'm not going to do your job for you. Bring me a problem and I'll work it with you, but I'm not going to take it off your plate and hand it back finished.

I'm hiring this seat because I want someone we can all learn from. Bring me a better answer than mine and I'll take it.

What You'll Bring

All required.

  • A full performance cycle you owned end to end, not supported. Owned more than once, at 150 people or more. Design, timeline, manager prep, calibration, rollout, retro.
  • Compensation and benefits you've owned. Band design, benchmarking methodology, benefits renewals, the annual comp cycle. You can defend a number to a CFO.
  • HR compliance as standing scope, not as a project. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. You've inherited a backlog and cleared it.
  • A people system that outlasted you. Built, adopted, and still recognizable two cycles later.
  • Leverage you built that people adopted. You've automated or rebuilt part of a people process so it ran faster, the quality held or improved, and the team actually used it. Adoption is the test here, the same way durability is the test above.
  • Experience taking a company our size to materially larger, on headcount or revenue, more than once. You know what breaks first at the next stage because you've watched it break.
  • Empowered your team to raise the bar. You have clear examples of coaching, mentoring, and growing a team that created extraordinary outcomes.

This is a player-coach seat. Managers here lead a team and deliver work personally, at every level.

Nice to Have

  • You have opinions about what performance management gets wrong, and specific examples of what you changed
  • You can tell a process problem from a manager-capability problem, and you fix the right one
  • You're the person who says the uncomfortable thing in a calibration room

What You'll Own

Performance management. The mid-year and annual cycles end to end: design, timeline, communication, execution. What the cycle needs to produce and what to cut. A timeline published early enough that managers plan around it. The retro after each one, and the judgment about when a change is warranted and when to leave it alone.

Total rewards. Band design and the benchmarking methodology behind it. Benefits renewals and the economics underneath them. The annual comp cycle, with leveling and pay kept connected.

Compliance. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. The current backlog, plus the escalation and coverage protocols that follow it.

Manager enablement. Preparing managers for real performance conversations, including the one where someone rated themselves higher than their manager did. The calibration process, including where two managers apply the same bar differently. Playbooks and self-service resources so a manager gets an answer without booking a meeting. Standing support for the roughly three dozen front-line managers who get it reactively today.

Leverage and tooling. Finding the parts of everything above that shouldn't be done by hand, and fixing them. Building what a manager will actually open rather than what looks good in a demo. Taking time out of the cycle while the conversations get better rather than thinner.

The team. An HR Business Partner and a Total Rewards and People Analytics lead. Both are strong at what they do and both have room to grow. You set their decision rights: where they decide, where they recommend, where it comes to you.

What Great Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The annual cycle ships on your timeline and you own it
  • Managers are calibrated before the cycle rather than corrected after it
  • Every person leaving a check-in has one clear thing to work on, and the conversation that produced it was a real one
  • The compliance backlog is closed and stays closed
  • The cycle costs managers less time than the year before, and the conversations are better rather than thinner
  • Your two reports hold more decision authority than they did at the start

This Isn't the Right Seat If

  • This would be your first Director-level people role
  • You lead with policy and risk. Compliance is required here and it isn't the center of the work
  • You want to redesign the cycle every year
  • You see tooling and automation as somebody else's job
  • You're looking for a recruiting role. Recruiting sits elsewhere in the function

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.
